title: Quantum Aikido: The Power of Harmony
author: Richard Moon
exact_source_text: What if conflict isn't something to win or lose, but energy waiting to be transformed? Creativity in the Unified Field bridges ancient wisdom with modern physics, teaching readers to transform conflict into creative harmony. Conflict as energy to harmonize, not defeat. Recognizing pressure as information. Channeling reactivity into creativity. Cyprus peace negotiations. Corporate coaching. High-stakes conflict. The floating bridge of heaven where convention meets creativity.
